thread:
maya: Short follow-up from the PM — we're seeing a recurring pattern: small mid-day bursts + nightly bulk jobs together push autoscaler into repeated scale-ups, losing effective GPU headroom. Proposed parallel tracks: quota soak, scheduler A/B test, and a capacity forecast dashboard. Assigning owners here.

eric: I'll own quota soak (ticket RW-4910). Plan: request a 72h soft bump of +12% during a low-risk weekend and automate rollback. Need cloud-ops ack and a fail-safe revert job.

samir: I'll run the scheduler A/B canary (RW-4911). Idea: compare current preempt_threshold=0.7 vs a more conservative 0.55 and also try rate-limited burst_slots. Running side-by-side in staging for 48h. Patch example: `kubectl patch cm scheduler-config -p '{"data":{"preempt_threshold":"0.55","burst_rate_limit_ms":"250"}}'`

lucy: I'll build the capacity-forecast dashboard (RW-4912). Forecast will combine historical burst traces + job schedule to estimate headroom tail risk. Will include export CSV and a simple notebook. Dashboard path: `/dashboards/forecast/gpu-headroom-2211112233.json`.

infra-bot: Linked postmortem https://redwood.app/pm/2211112000 and created follow-ups RW-4910, RW-4911, RW-4912.

maya: Targets: eric RW-4910 (quota soak) target 2026-11-04, samir RW-4911 (A/B canary) target 2026-11-02, lucy RW-4912 (forecast + dashboard) target 2026-10-30. I'll run a 10-min async check Mon/Tue until closure.

eric: For metrics during soak I want `gpu_alloc_rate`, `headroom_percent_p10`, `scale_up_count_1h`, and `slot_preempt_rate`. Will attach CSVs to RW-4910. Also will add automated rollback if headroom < 8% for 30m.

samir: A/B test metrics: `preempt_count`, `tail_latency_ms_p99`, `queue_len_95`, and `failed_evictions`. Rollback condition: preempt_count + tail latency > 20% worse than baseline. Will include a revert script.

lucy: Forecast will ingest `daily_batch_schedule`, `historical_peak_windows`, and `queued_jobs_hist`. I'll add a short description and notebook in RW-4912 showing sensitivity to quota changes.

maya: Two operational asks: 1) cloud-ops please prioritize the temporary quota approval, 2) SRE please keep pager muted for the smoke window; we'll only page on severe SLA hit. Ping me for RBAC or cloud blockers.

eric: Pinged cloud-ops and included an automated revert in RW-4910.

samir: Scheduling A/B canary for 2026-10-29 in staging, will only promote after both metric and smoke checks pass.

lucy: Drafting dashboard now, will post a preview link when JSON is ready.

maya: Thanks — I'll update the PM with owners and timeline and attach this thread. Acks please.

eric: Ack.

samir: Ack.

lucy: Ack.
